en.title: Account Security & Password Recovery
en.excerpt: Guide to securing your Archeris account, email OTP verifications, password resets, and session management.
en.content:
Email Verification & OTP Codes

To prevent unauthorized account creation and protect your tournament registrations, Archeris utilizes email verification using time-sensitive One-Time Passwords (OTP):

  • Upon registration or sensitive security updates, a 6-digit numeric OTP code is dispatched to your registered email address.
  • OTP codes expire automatically after 5 minutes for enhanced security.
  • If you do not see the email in your primary inbox within 60 seconds, check your Spam/Junk folder and click Resend Code if necessary.

Updating Your Password

You can change your password at any time from your account settings:

  1. Go to Settings > Security > Change Password.
  2. Enter your Current Password to authenticate your identity.
  3. Enter your New Password (minimum 8 characters, recommended combination of letters, numbers, and symbols).
  4. Click Update Password. Your active session will be refreshed immediately.

Password Recovery & Reset Workflow

If you cannot recall your account password:

  1. Navigate to the login page and click Forgot Password?.
  2. Enter your registered email address and submit the request.
  3. Check your inbox for a secure password reset link containing a cryptographic verification token.
  4. Click the link, enter your new desired password, and confirm. You can now log in with your updated credentials.

Session Security & Best Practices

To keep your tournament data and organizer billing balances secure:

  • Never Share Credentials: Committee members and tournament field staff should never share personal master passwords. Use dedicated temporary Scorekeeper codes for field staff instead.
  • Shared Devices: If logging in from a public scoring desk or communal archery club tablet, always click Logout from the profile dropdown when finishing your session.
  • Secure HTTPS: Ensure you are always accessing Archeris over encrypted SSL/TLS connections (https://archeris.net).
